entries.positive_observation: The high bald crown, short gray side/back hair and narrow gray sideburns, thick dark brows, clean-shaven upper lip and chin, and lack of headgear or glasses follow the visible source. The yellow mascot has green-ringed solid black eyes, one stern closed mouth and no human nose, ears or skin. The image-left three-quarter pose and gaze, soft left illumination and darker right modeling remain. The dark gray-green uniform retains two silver leaf-like collar patches, silver shoulder details, pale piping, gray shirt and dark green tie in their source positions and counts. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib. The full pale gray-beige mottled backplate is continuous through all corners and around the crown; no frame, note, halo or replacement studio was added.
entries.alpha_decision: Approve the RGB art only for a later source-alpha BILINEAR repair. The unchanged return is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema=null, while the source is RGBA with extrema [251,255]; it is not yet approved for production. The complete raw and white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet show a continuous backplate with no visible holes or lost corners. No alpha repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine collar-leaf embroidery and shoulder-detail interiors cannot be transcribed exactly at 156x210. Their visible shapes, counts and placements were checked; no approval rests on a claim of exact unreadable heraldry.
